title: Take the Wheel
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about changing who you are. On foot, Yana walks and jumps over a bird in the road, then steps into a little kart. The next level names a different character file: the kart is fast, cannot jump and has a horn. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and make your own.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie jumps a bird, then climbs into a little blue kart. The next level uses a different character file: faster, no jump, and a horn that clears the road. Play it, then open the game in Game-Maker and make your own kart, boat or rocket.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A level can name a different character file
Made to be copied and taken apart
